row.body: A sample bottle is paired with a fuel ledger; the entry says the test was routine, then asks the next shift not to use the same hose.
row.title: The second fuel sample

sidecar.gloss: A routine test ends with a request to stop using the hose.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency crew could isolate a hose after contamination or damage; the record does not identify the test.
